name: M.338 200 FCG (MAXIMUS, 200 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".399 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footer: the coefficient numbers are confirmed by independent testing and by the Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".200 EST". Marked EST: estimated; the page states no accuracy. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
